lines: init:  roll out with the hinted prompt until a trajectory passes (at most `init_attempts` tries)
move:  cut x at a uniformly random turn j, keep turns < j, regenerate turns >= j with the hinted prompt -> x';
-           reject x' if it does not pass; otherwise keep it when it scores at least as well as the current state
-           under the student, using the paper's length-normalised score (App. C.2),
-               s(x) = (1 / |x|) * sum_t log pi(x_t | x_<t, plain prompt)   over the policy's own tokens.
+           reject x' if it does not pass; otherwise accept it with the Metropolis-Hastings probability for the
+           target above. Writing S_pi(y) for the sum of log pi over the policy's own tokens of y, S_q for the
+           same sum under the hinted prompt over the regenerated suffix only, and T for the number of turns,
+               log alpha = [S_pi(x') - S_pi(x)] + [S_q(x suffix) - S_q(x' suffix)] + log(T_x / T_x'),
+           where the second bracket is the proposal-ratio correction q(x | x') / q(x' | x) (the shared prefix
+           cancels) and the last term is the ratio of the uniform cut probabilities. Sums, not per-token means:
+           the target is a density over whole trajectories, so a longer candidate must pay for every token.
